Docs/ Theme development/Golementor and Hello Golementor

Golementor and Hello Golementor

The page builder's base theme, the Theme Builder, saved themes and how they relate to theme packages.

Golementor is Pursae's visual page builder — a built-in plugin, off on a fresh install, activated under Plugins. It brings its own base theme, Hello Golementor, and a Theme Builder for headers, footers, single and archive templates, popups and loops.

Hello Golementor

A blank canvas theme (web/themes/hello-gowebeditor): minimal markup, no styling of its own, the right place for a design built entirely in the builder. It appears on the Themes screen only while Golementor is active; deactivating the plugin switches the site to Twenty Sixteen (the Plugins screen says so) and hides everything the builder added. Saved themes and built pages are kept in the database and return on the next activation.

Theme parts

Appearance › Theme Builder (and the Golementor menu) edits theme parts: documents of type gwe_template with a part type (header, footer, single-post, single-page, archive, search-results, error-404) and display conditions (include/general, include/singular/page/12, exclude/archive/category/3, …). When Hello Golementor is active — or when a part's conditions match a page on another bundled theme — the page renders through the Hello Golementor templates: wp_head, the header part, the matching single/archive/404 part (or the template's own minimal markup), the footer part, wp_footer.

Parts, global styles ("Site Settings": fonts, colours, custom CSS) and the kit live in the database, not in files.

Save as theme

The Theme Builder's Save as theme takes a snapshot of the current design — kit settings and custom CSS, every theme part with its element tree, page settings and display conditions, and the menu locations — and stores it as a saved theme (a row of the themes table with custom = true). Saved themes:

  • appear in their own section on the Themes screen with a generated or uploaded screenshot;
  • can be live previewed with their own global styles;
  • when activated, load the snapshot into the site's working copy and make Hello Golementor the active theme;
  • are fixed: editing the site afterwards changes the working copy, not the saved theme. Save again to make a new one;
  • can be exported as a zip (with manifest.json and the media they reference) and imported on another site.

How this relates to theme packages

Theme package Saved Golementor theme
Made with an editor and theme.json the visual builder
Stored as files under <data>/themes/<slug> a database row + kit post
Distributed as zip with templates/assets (Hub themes) Golementor export zip
Needs Golementor no yes (it renders through Hello Golementor)
Customizer sections from theme.json Golementor's Site Settings

A theme package can coexist with Golementor: pages edited with the builder render inside the package's templates through the_content, and the builder's theme parts take over only when their display conditions say so.
